To the girl who changed everything, 💗

We've only just begun this, you and me — but somehow you already feel like my favorite part of every single day, my favorite person to text good morning, my favorite reason to smile at my phone like an idiot. Today the whole world gets to celebrate you turning eighteen, and I just get to feel lucky that I get to call you mine while it happens. 🌸

I hope this year hands you everything you're quietly hoping for, and a few things you didn't even know to ask for. Here's to more firsts, more inside jokes, more falling for you a little harder every day, and many, many more birthdays by your side. I love you more than these words know how to say. 💕🌷💖

— always, hopelessly yours
